title: RISS Program award records, performance reporting, and 28 CFR Part 23 compliance records (FY2019-present)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The Bureau of Justice Assistance administers the Regional Information Sharing Systems (RISS) Program through annual awards to six regional centers, the RISS Technology Support Center (RTSC), and technical service providers including the Institute for Intergovernmental Research (IIR). In 2017, in response to OJP FOIA No. 17-00253, OJP located and produced RISS award records. I request the following existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified from January 1, 2019 to the present:

1. Award notices and award documents for RISS Program awards, including the six regional center awards, the RTSC award, and awards to IIR (including grant 15PBJA-21-GK-02790-RISS and successor awards), limited to cover pages, award amounts, period of performance, and special conditions;

2. The portions of statements of work, program narratives, and budget narratives for those awards that describe the development, operation, maintenance, or composition of RISSNET, RISSIntel, RISSafe, or related RISS applications;

3. Quarterly and semi-annual performance reports and deliverables submitted to BJA under those awards, limited to sections describing RISSNET or RISSIntel capabilities, architecture, interfaces, or development activity;

4. Records of BJA or OJP compliance reviews, monitoring, audits, or site visits concerning the RISS Program's operation of criminal intelligence systems under 28 C.F.R. Part 23, including findings and corrective actions;

5. The portions of the Department's custom-code inventory maintained under OMB Memorandum M-16-21 that cover OJP or BJA systems, including any entries for RISSNET, RISSIntel, or other RISS applications.

This request does not seek criminal intelligence data contained in RISS databases, and it does not seek source code. I prefer electronic delivery. Please notify me in advance if fees will exceed $50.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robin Monks
